sol.10: Switch to the window you want to add. An amber countdown banner shows 4s and Cancel above the Preview app card.

sol.13: Could not quit Logi Options+. A red-tinted banner puts Try again and Dismiss together at the right edge.
sol.14: Start with Windows. A checkmark appears beside it in both tray captures, where Pause remapping changes to Resume remapping.
sol.01: Buttons. The open Profile menu marks Default with a check and lists Preview app below it.
sol.02: Haptic Sense Panel. The MX Master 4 diagram adds marker 6 inside the thumb panel, and Additional button 1 appears separately with Control ID 0x01FF.
sol.03: Gesture button tap. Win and Tab appear as separate keycaps before Task View in the compact mapping list.
sol.04: Back button. The open category list marks Common with a check, and choosing Edit shows six tiles with Copy and Paste in the first row.
sol.05: No matching actions. The unmatched query stays visible with a Record a keyboard shortcut button directly below the message.
sol.06: Switch between two pointer speeds. The editor shows separate 800 and 1600 DPI sliders above the full-width save button.
sol.07: Saved shortcut. Reopening shows K beside Assigned now and again in the preview, with Done at the lower left.

terra.01: Buttons; profile menu shows Default checked and Preview app.

astra.01: Buttons and Profile. Default has an amber check in the open selector, and the mouse illustration has five numbered markers in both themes.
astra.02: Haptic Sense Panel and Other reported buttons. MX Master 4 adds marker 6 on the thumb panel, while Additional button 1 appears in its own full-width row with Edit action. Offline frames retain the five-marker illustration and show Disconnected.
astra.03: Gesture button tap. The compact mapping list shows Win and Tab keycaps beside Task View, and the offline list has a No device sidebar card.
astra.04: Thumb buttons and Tabs & windows. The selected Native action tile has an amber border and check. The compact picker shows a tile called New with Ctrl + N. The haptic editor pairs marker 6 with a close-up of the thumb panel.
astra.05: No matching actions. Copy produces an Edit result row with Ctrl and C keycaps plus an Assign button. The empty result offers Record a keyboard shortcut beneath the search field.
astra.06: Switch between two pointer speeds. Two amber sliders show Speed 1: 800 DPI and Speed 2: 1600 DPI, followed by a full-width Save pointer speed action button.
astra.07: Saved shortcut. Ordered frames show Actions, New shortcut, Press a key, M draft, a compact resize retaining M and Save shortcut, cancel returning Native action, K ready, K assigned, then reopened Saved shortcut K with Done. Both themes retain the full compact dialog footer.
astra.08: Ignore accidental nudges. SmartShift is selected with an amber radio border, the nudge value is 4, and the limited view omits both slider sections.
astra.09: Saved gesture actions. Swipe left has Ctrl, Win and left-arrow keycaps. The off frame retains editable gesture rows below an explanatory sentence and a gray toggle.
astra.10: Switch to the window you want to add. The capture banner shows 4s beside Cancel. Profile order frames put Move down on Preview app and Move up on Photo editor.
astra.11: Reapply settings and No device. The connected view has a green half-full battery bar and Current DPI 1000. Disconnected and empty views use a crossed mouse icon, while USB mouse shows a single connection card.
astra.12: HID++ features and Unnamed features. Named features align amber hexadecimal IDs on the left, while unknown IDs form two rows of chips beside Copy IDs.
astra.13: Couldn't save assignment. The editor retains the thumb-button close-up and provides Try again plus Back to editing. The conflict banner uses amber for Logi Options+ is running and red for Could not quit Logi Options+.
astra.14: Start with Windows. A check appears at the left of that native menu item, while Pause remapping changes to Resume remapping in the second frame.
